text: I think you'll enjoy this Banana Spice Bars recipe, given your affinity for baked goods and yeast-based recipes. The presence of baking powder and whole wheat flour aligns with your preferences. While this recipe isn't vegan, it's worth noting that you may be open to non-vegan options. The nutritional profile of this recipe is relatively balanced, with a moderate amount of fat and carbohydrates. The preparation time is slightly longer than your average liked recipe, but it's still within a reasonable range.
